meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱提问并理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库或审查代码结构
copy.tagline_en: Ask questions and understand codebases using a knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand unfamiliar code or review code structure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取项目中的知识图谱文件，根据你的问题搜索相关代码节点、函数、类等，并解释它们之间的关系和所属架构层。
howto.when: 当你询问关于代码库的问题，比如某个函数的作用、文件之间的依赖关系时触发。

say.text: 这个项目中 main.py 调用了哪些函数？
say.note: Claude 会搜索知识图谱并列出调用关系。

say.text: 解释一下 user_service 类的功能。
say.note: Claude 会查找该类节点并给出摘要。
Claude 会搜索依赖边并列出上游文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the project's knowledge graph file, searches for relevant code nodes (files, functions, classes, etc.) based on your query, and explains their relationships and architectural layers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions about the codebase, such as the role of a function or dependencies between files.

say_en.text: What functions does main.py call in this project?
say_en.note: Claude searches the graph and lists call relationships.
Claude finds the node and gives its summary.
Claude searches dependency edges and lists upstream files.
